about: BN5's KnightSoul's chip charge in both engines (the Souls track's S5): KnightSoul united (its flag 000C, souls6 0x10) with a deck of JustcOne J (BN5's chip 216, BN6's 140: Break, KnightSoul's kind), two picked, the last given up for UNITE; A held from t100 for 130 frames: the chip charged by BN5's rule (BN5 0x08010902: a chip of the Soul's kind; BN6's test 0x08013236 answered so for a Soul, src/emu/soulchips.c), its charge time BN5's (0x12's row), released at t232 as the chip used charged (BN5 0x0800D9E8; BN6's release 0x0800FBA4 sent to the chip's use for the Souls' empty power attacks) and doubled (BN5 0x080103C8: 0xFF, his damage once more; BN6's bonus 0x08012C7C answered so).
